title: Add ChatMessageEntry.unreadCount field
description: Spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-push-00) defines ChatMessageEntry.unreadCount as UnsignedInt|null optional — total unread across non-muted Chats at push generation time. Servers SHOULD include for APNs aps.badge. Missing from crate-jmap-chat-types/src/push.rs.
close_reason: Added ChatMessageEntry.unread_count: Option<u64> (push-00 §5.2). Test chat_message_entry_unread_count_typed_and_optional. Server still rejects unreadCount in properties (push.rs ENTRY_PROPERTIES, not built; SHOULD-level).
